name: Necklace of Force Beads
body:
Price 500 gp; Aura faint evocation; CL 1; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This is a string of clear glass beads on a silver chain that is tied together to form a necklace.

This does not need to be worn as a neck slot item to be used. The glass beads can be removed by the user (and only the user), who can toss them as a standard action.

Once in the air, the bead turns into a magic missile and strikes a target of the user. If you have multiple attacks in a full-attack action from your Bab and not from two-weapon fighting, feats, or multiple natural attacks, you can retrieve and toss a number of beads equal to your number of attacks per round. This includes extra attacks from effects such as haste.

Each necklace begins with 10 beads but can be found with fewer beads. Each bead expended reduces the necklace’s cost by 50 gp.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 250 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells magic missile
